description: This file is a shell script used for scheduling and executing log uploads, telemetry data processing, and system maintenance tasks in a device management context. It includes functions for random timing, log handling, and system checks, as well as logic for periodic execution based on time conditions.

methods.name: calcRandTimeandUpload
methods.description: Calculates random hours, minutes, and seconds, then sleeps for that duration before performing system maintenance and log upload tasks.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Determines the build type (DEV, VBN, PROD, CQA) based on the /version.txt file.

methods.name: getTFTPServer
methods.description: Retrieves the TFTP server address based on the build type.
